expectations.text: Rejects the per-audience-segment channel architecture as proposed.

expectations.text: States the operability reason: segment membership is a fresh judgement call on every message, and writers resolve it by cross-posting, which rebuilds the noise the segments were meant to remove.
expectations.evidence: "resolves it by cross-posting, which recreates the noise the segments were meant to remove."

expectations.text: States per-segment channels are legitimate only when segments are genuinely disjoint and stable for the whole event.

expectations.text: Names writer operability as the deciding axis: a volunteer must route a message correctly on the first try with nobody to ask.

expectations.text: Rejects the mirrored Telegram group outright rather than keeping it as a secondary channel: a second chat platform running the same job doubles moderation and halves each announcement's audience.
